project_type: Hardhat Solidity project with ES modules, Coffee/Cacao specialized traceability and DEX
language: Solidity 0.8.37 (^0.8.24 for Coffee/Cacao contracts), JavaScript (ES modules)
build_system: Hardhat 3.18.1 with @nomicfoundation/hardhat-ethers plugin, optimizer enabled with viaIR, 200 runs
test_framework: Hardhat test framework (needs setup) - use JavaScript test files under blockchain/tests/
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run blockchain:compile to compile contracts. 2. Run npx hardhat test to run all tests. 3. Verify no compilation errors and all tests pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: blockchain/artifacts/ contains compiled contract artifacts (ABIs, bytecode). Generated by npm run blockchain:compile. Not checked into git.
environment_constraints: ES modules only (type: module in package.json). OpenZeppelin 5.6.1 uses new import paths. AgroChainCoffeeCacaoTraceability.sol has certification validation: isBatchCertified(bytes32 batchId, bool isCoffee) returns bool. Coffee varieties: Arabica, Robusta/Conilon. Cacao varieties: Criollo, Forastero, Trinitario, Nacional. EUDR compliance mandatory. Solidity 0.8.37 with built-in overflow protection. No tests directory exists yet - must be created.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing project structure: contracts in blockchain/contracts/, scripts in blockchain/scripts/, tests in blockchain/tests/. Use ES module syntax. Maintain compatibility with existing AgroChainCoffeeCacaoTraceability deployment. Deploy scripts should follow pattern of existing deploy-sepolia.mjs. EXCLUSIVE FOCUS: Coffee (Arabica, Robusta/Conilon) and Cacao tokens only - remove all Soja/Milho references.
key_patterns: Contracts use OpenZeppelin 5.x with access control patterns (Ownable), ReentrancyGuard for security, custom errors instead of require strings. Coffee/Cacao contracts use enums for varieties and processing methods. Scripts use ethers v6.17.0 with ES module syntax. Config uses hardhat/config with profiles for solidity versions.
directory_structure: blockchain/ contains contracts/, scripts/, circuits/, artifacts/, cache/. Root contains package.json with ES module type. No existing cafeswap/ subdirectory - needs creation. No tests/ directory - needs creation. AgroChainCoffeeCacaoTraceability.sol already exists with Coffee/Cacao batch management.
